name: AnythingLLM v1 Private AI Workspace (RAG + Agents)
description: Chat with your documents, RAG and AI agents. Password on by default.

upstream.anythingllm: Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm v1.20.0 (MIT), image mintplexlabs/anythingllm:1.20.0 pinned by index digest

AUTH_TOKEN.description: Sign-in password (single-user password mode), generated at deploy. 8-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 _ - ! @ $ % ^ & * ( ) ; or the instance locks until you fix it.

JWT_SECRET.description: Signs session tokens. Generated at deploy; changing it signs everyone out.

SIG_KEY.description: Encryption key for stored credentials. Generated at deploy; never change it once data exists.

SIG_SALT.description: Encryption salt paired with SIG_KEY. Generated at deploy; never change it once data exists.

STORAGE_DIR.description: Data directory on the Railway volume: database, documents, vectors (LanceDB), models and saved settings.

PORT.description: Port Railway's healthcheck and public domain use; keep it equal to SERVER_PORT.

DISABLE_TELEMETRY.description: true = send no anonymous usage telemetry to Mintplex Labs.

OPEN_AI_KEY.description: Optional. OpenAI API key; pick OpenAI as the LLM in onboarding. Leave empty to enter keys in the UI.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Anthropic API key for Claude models.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Optional. OpenRouter API key (hundreds of models with one key).
